rows.text: Orange-red crown wash with a dark-red lips-shaped core on the bald dome. Absent in S1/S2 (clean GLB scalp), present in the stage-3 INPUT solved-albedo-bb.png and every chain output. Lineage: baseT-4096 plain at blob box; compose-albedo (face_replay_compose.py scalp_apply, r1 cmd with --skip-join) carries the lips; solve/replay/chain preserve it. Source: the locked donor island (island-T.png 1408x736) blended raw-resized without registration (treat_frac 0.919, tone_shift_L -23.83 per port5/compose-report.json); blob template-matches the donor mouth (NCC 0.915) and lands outside body2's eroded facecore keep-out. Current code refuses this input (crown_step_over_bound, b3167aa35); r1 ran before the refusal and carried the paint to the sheet.

rows.text: Iris renders red-brown (iris-ring mean 125,84,66, R-G 40) and sclera pink-grey vs Aisha (84,70,62, R-G 15; white sclera) under the identical rig. Present already in the S1 base-GLB render (skinOverride null), so no station stage introduces it: the brown_eye asset itself is reddish (red-brown iris, pink-veined sclera) while Aisha's iris-centred-c is neutral. The stage-5 eye flags carry no per-subject value and materialOverrides is empty; lid-conform (S4) re-seats the globes (sclera reads whiter) but the iris redness persists. Measured on 1280px fronts with the r2 rig/camera.
